## POST `/api/2.29/smb-client-policies/rules`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

Add an SMB Client policy rule. Rules are ordered in three groups; ip addresses, other and `*`. The new rule will be added at the end of the appropriate group if neither `before_rule_id` nor `before_rule_name` are specified. Rules can only be inserted into the appropriate group. The `policy_ids` or `policy_names` parameter is required, but they cannot be set together.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-ID` | header | string |  | Supplied by client during request or generated by server. |
| `before_rule_id` | query | string |  | The id of the rule to insert or move a rule before. This cannot be provided together with the `before_rule_name` query parameter. |
| `before_rule_name` | query | string |  | The name of the rule to insert or move a rule before. This cannot be provided together with the `before_rule_id` query parameter. |
| `context_names` | query | array of string |  | Performs the operation on the context specified. If specified, the context names must be an array of size 1, and the single element must be the name of an array in the same fleet or the name of the fleet itself. If not… |
| `policy_ids` | query | array of string |  | A comma-separated list of policy IDs. If after filtering, there is not at least one resource that matches each of the elements of `policy_ids`, then an error is returned. This cannot be provided together with the… |
| `policy_names` | query | array of string |  | A comma-separated list of policy names. |
| `versions` | query | array of string |  | A comma-separated list of versions. This is an optional query param used for concurrency control. The ordering should match the names or ids query param. This will fail with a 412 Precondition failed if the resource… |

**Request body** (required): `SmbClientPolicyRulePost`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (read-only) | A non-modifiable, globally unique ID chosen by the system. |
| `name` | string (read-only) | Name of the object (e.g., a file system or snapshot). |
| `client` | string | Specifies the clients that will be permitted to access the export. Accepted notation is a single IP address, subnet in CIDR notation, or anonymous (`*`). The default is `*` if not specified. |
| `encryption` | string | Specifies whether the remote client is required to use SMB encryption. Valid values are `required`, `disabled`, and `optional`. If not specified, defaults to `optional`. |
| `permission` | string | Specifies which read-write client access permissions are allowed for the export. Valid values are `rw` and `ro`. The default is `ro` if not specified. |
| `index` | integer (int32) | The index within the policy. The `index` indicates the order the rules are evaluated. NOTE: It is recommended to use the query param `before_rule_id` to do reordering to avoid concurrency issues, but changing `index`… |

**Responses:** `200` OK → `SmbClientPolicyRuleResponse`
